text: Your desk. A folded map of Veldras, three months old and already wrong.
Somebody has circled the Hollow Sea and written NOT DUE FOR ELEVEN YEARS.
Underneath, in different ink: so why is it happening now.
Shelves of your father's field journals, carried the whole way here.
Every one of them ends the same way: I will finish this next season.
Your bed. Made, for once, because you did not sleep in it much.
You have been awake since the sky went grey.
A small television on a crate, and a rug you brought from the old house.
It is the only corner of this room that still smells like home.
